item.itunes:summary: Writers, designers, actors, coders, musicians, thinkers — they’re all worried about being replaced by machines. But what if the A.I.s are actually here to help? (Part one of a two-part series.)

item.title: Are Private Equity Firms Plundering the U.S. Economy? (Update)
item.author: editor@freakonomics.com (Freakonomics Radio + Stitcher)
item.itunes:title: Are Private Equity Firms Plundering the U.S. Economy? (Update)

item.itunes:summary: They say they make companies more efficient through savvy management. Critics say they bend the rules to enrich themselves at the expense of consumers and employees. Can they both be right? (Probably not.)
